disclaimer: Educational / research prototype. NOT for diagnosis, treatment decisions, treatment-response prediction, or prognosis. Model scores are uncalibrated class scores, never disease probabilities.

encoder_weights.note: ImageNet MobileNetV3-small encoder the recovered head was fitted against. This is NOT the recovered head bundle; that identity is recorded separately above.

original_frozen_model.note: The original G4 bundle is absent and stays absent. Its hash is never reassigned to the recovered head.

torch_stack.note: Optional. The web serve path is torch-free by design; this stack is imported lazily by attribution and live inference only.

wsi_engines.fallback_note: The Pillow fallback reports only genuinely present metadata. mpp / objective_power / vendor are null when the file does not carry them — they are never estimated.
